findings.description: Static model-policy ownership is cleanly separated between agents.yaml (harness identity, eligibility, transport, credentials, endpoint metadata, and invocation mechanics such as model_flag) and archetypes.yaml (sole curated authority for exact agent-harness + dispatch-kind ordered ModelSpec chains), delegating dynamic candidate selection to the coordinator catalog.
findings.resolution: Retain D14 and the dedicated wp-model-config-ownership package in the implementation plan.

findings.description: Tasks 4.7-4.9 and wp-model-config-ownership establish a safe migration sequence (characterization, versioned route resolution, and consumer migration) covering sync CLI, async CLI, SDK, discovery, bridge/API, and health consumers without reliance on ambient defaults.
findings.resolution: Preserve task execution order 4.7 -> 4.8 -> 4.9 and package dependencies.

findings.description: Work-package DAG dependencies, file/key locks, write scopes, and verification steps across all 8 packages are fully specified, acyclic, and parallel-safe.
findings.resolution: Execute work packages according to the work-packages.yaml DAG.

findings.description: Cedar policy rules enforce hard feasibility constraints—such as subscription EULA programmatic-ineligibility and data residency floors—prior to scoring, ensuring non-compliant models are excluded before candidate ranking.
findings.resolution: Verify Cedar constraint evaluation runs pre-scoring in wp-resolver.

findings.description: The 2-second resolver timeout and ROUTING_ADAPTIVE feature flag guarantee deterministic fallback to static archetypes.yaml model chains without ambient harness defaults or central coordinator single-point-of-failure lock-in.
findings.resolution: Enforce timeout fallback logging and static route resolution in agents_config.py.

findings.description: The usage dashboard (apps/usage-viz) and telemetry correctly surface success-adjusted cost-per-completed-task per model x task-type as the primary comparison metric, supported by OpenTelemetry coordinator signals and estimate labelling.
findings.resolution: Render cost-per-completed-task as headline metric with estimated-spend visual indicators.

findings.description: Nit: Phase 6 task numbering in tasks.md places task 6.6 after tasks 6.7 and 6.8, resulting in a minor non-sequential task label ordering.
findings.resolution: Optionally re-order task 6.6 to appear before task 6.7 in Phase 6 of tasks.md.
